EM2_late_answer_painted._note: E15 reddens by mechanism: without the re-check after the answer, the answer of a page left meanwhile is painted too.

EM3_stale_render_queries._note: The only staleness check after an await. A second check right before the query was defensive (no await since the render-time check when the fill did not wait) — the first matrix proved it with 0 reds, and it was removed.

EM4_block_error_propagates._note: E16 reddens by mechanism: a propagated error draws no error element at all.

EM9_left_page_kept._note: The review's X2: a fill of a page that was left still queries (and, out of order, a second time). E15 reddens by the same mechanism after the answer.

EM10_stale_birth_paints._note: E10 reddens by mechanism: with the index stable no await precedes the query, so this render-time check is the only guard before the provider — without it the page left before its render reached the block (E10) queries too. Since the duplicate pre-query check was dropped, the guard covers both the paint (E12) and the query.

EM14_block_error_as_html._note: Review M2: the error a block draws must not interpret its title or message as HTML.
